info.title: Fresh Bites API
info.description: REST API for the Fresh Bites application

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Delivery order creation and management endpoints

tags.name: Payments
tags.description: Authenticated payment creation and retrieval. Demo is the safe default; Bakong payment processing is not yet enabled.

put.description: Updates only supplied fields. Omitted fields remain unchanged; imageUrl may be null to clear it. _id and createdAt cannot be updated.

delete.description: A category referenced by any product cannot be deleted.

put.description: Replaces the product fields. Omitted description and imageUrl values are cleared.

post.description: Creates an unverified customer account, stores no plaintext OTP, and sends a six-digit verification code by email. The code expires after 10 minutes and registration always assigns the customer role.

example.message: Registration successful. Verify the OTP sent to your email.

example.error: A user with this email already exists

post.description: Verifies a single-use six-digit code. Codes expire after 10 minutes and allow at most five attempts.
Sends a new code for eligible unverified accounts. Resends have a one-minute cooldown; the response does not disclose whether an account exists or is eligible.

202.description: Request accepted without disclosing account status

example.error: Email verification is required before login
Invalid user data or user id

put.description: Users may update their own profile; admins may update any user. Role changes are not allowed through this endpoint.

400.description: Invalid update data or user ID

example.error: Invalid user data or user id

403.description: Can only update your own profile

example.error: A user with this email already exists

delete.description: Users may delete their own account; admins may delete any user.

example.error: Invalid user data or user id

403.description: Can only delete your own account

get.description: Customers receive only their own orders. Admins can list every order.

post.description: Creates an order for the authenticated customer. Replace the illustrative productId in the example with the id of an existing, available product from GET /products. Product names and prices are read from MongoDB; client-supplied prices and totals are rejected. Delivery fee is currently zero because the project has no configured fee.

404.description: One or more products were not found

409.description: One or more products are unavailable

get.description: Customers can retrieve only their own orders; admins can retrieve any order. Orders owned by another customer are returned as not found.

put.description: Admin only. Allowed transitions are pending to confirmed/cancelled, confirmed to preparing/cancelled, preparing to out_for_delivery, and out_for_delivery to delivered. Orders with a pending or failed online payment cannot advance to preparing.
Customers may cancel only their own pending orders. Admins may cancel pending or confirmed orders. Cancellation is blocked while payment is pending or already paid.

get.description: Customers receive only their own payments. Admins can list every payment.

post.description: Creates one pending payment for the authenticated customer's eligible order. Amount and currency come from MongoDB; client totals are not accepted. The default demo provider returns a unique reference, no QR data, and an explicit simulation label. Demo payments never complete or mark an order paid. Bakong mode is unavailable until an approved server-side KHQR SDK and official SIT setup are installed.

get.description: Customers can retrieve only their own payments; admins can retrieve any payment. Payments owned by another customer are returned as not found.

put.description: Admin only. Allowed transitions are pending to failed and completed to refunded. This endpoint cannot mark a payment completed; completion is reserved for trusted provider verification. The corresponding order paymentStatus is updated as well.

currency.description: Copied from the persisted order; not accepted from clients.

provider.description: Provider label, or cash_on_delivery for COD payments.

isDemo.description: True only for a local simulation; demo mode does not process payments.

providerTransactionId.description: Trusted provider transaction identity; unique across payments.

qrData.description: Generated by an approved provider SDK. Null in demo mode.

message.description: Demo-mode notice when the payment is simulated.

_id.description: MongoDB ObjectId serialized as a string

deliveryFee.description: Currently zero; no delivery fee policy is configured.

currency.description: Stored with the order and used as the payment currency.

productId.description: Must be the id of an existing product from GET /products.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email address has been verified

email.description: Changing the email address clears its verification status and revokes existing access tokens.

Conflict.description: Duplicate category name or category referenced by products

example.error: A category with this name already exists
Email verification is temporarily unavailable. Correct the SMTP configuration and request a new OTP.

OrderBadRequest.description: Invalid order input or MongoDB ObjectId

example.error: Invalid order data or order id

OrderNotFound.description: Order not found or not accessible

OrderConflict.description: The requested order status transition is not permitted

example.error: Order status transition is not permitted

PaymentBadRequest.description: Invalid payment input or MongoDB ObjectId

example.error: Invalid payment data or payment id

PaymentNotFound.description: Order or payment not found or not accessible

PaymentConflict.description: A payment already exists or the status transition is not permitted

example.error: Payment is already created or status change is not allowed
